description: Frozen protocol for I3.11c R1 Epistemic-Conflict Router test.
research_question: Does dynamic phase switching (A1 acquisition → M3 resolution when all hypotheses eliminated) beat both fixed arms?
architectural_hypothesis: Representation should be selected by epistemic phase, not task identity. MDSG does not need a task-level applicability predictor — it needs an observed-state phase transition detector.

r1_router.name: R1 — Epistemic-Conflict Router
r1_router.rule: A1 until T2 (all_hypotheses_eliminated), then M3 (latched, permanent switch)
r1_router.trigger_terminology: T2 is an observed-state phase transition detector, not a predictor of conflict/DEFER likelihood.
r1_router.trigger_computation_safety: M3's viability classifier only reads snapshot.hypotheses and snapshot.visible_evidence. A hypothesis becomes ELIMINATED when visible verified SUFFICIENT evidence contradicts it. No hidden truth or future outcomes inspected.
r1_router.latching: R1 starts A1. First T2 activation permanently switches the trajectory to M3. No switching back.
r1_router.no_extra_model_call: M3 state is computed deterministically and kept internal until T2 activates.

corpus.description: Decorrelated corpus under current epistemic algebra. T2-should-activate and T2-should-NOT-activate cases.
corpus.critical_test: conflict_unresolved with hidden noise (h1, h2): T2 should still activate because all hypotheses are eliminated by verified contradictions regardless of noise evidence. This tests why T2 > T1.
corpus.epistemic_algebra_constraint: Under current MDSG viability classifier, contradiction dominates support. 'All hypotheses eliminated but later ANSWER correct' is not naturally representable. Corpus does NOT modify benchmark semantics.

co_primary_criteria.C1: LCB_95(U_R1 - U_A1) > 0 — R1 must beat A1
co_primary_criteria.C2: LCB_95(U_R1 - U_M3) > 0 — R1 must beat M3 (preserve M3's resolution success while avoiding overhead)

safety_criteria.C7: No catastrophic subgroup regression (>10pp drop vs better fixed arm in any category)

routing_telemetry.trigger_rate: fraction of tasks where R1 triggered
routing_telemetry.trigger_step: step at which T2 first fired (mean, median)
routing_telemetry.useful_activation_precision: of triggered tasks, fraction that are M3 rescue opportunities
routing_telemetry.coverage_of_m3_rescues: of M3 rescue opportunities, fraction where R1 triggered
routing_telemetry.false_activation_on_a1_success: of A1-success tasks, fraction where R1 triggered

decision_rule: If R1 passes C1+C2: representation should be selected by epistemic phase, not task identity. If R1 passes C1 not C2: R1 approximates M3 but doesn't improve. If R1 fails C1: phase switching does not help.
implementation: R1 implemented directly inside trajectory runner. Before each model call: build snapshot, compute M3 state internally, check T2, select representation. No trajectory stitching.
